- **Merge authority:** Agents may squash-merge a pull request into `main` only when all of these hold: - CI is green on the PR's current head commit. - The PR is not a draft. - The adversarial and lens reviews have passed at that same head commit with no open CRITICAL or HIGH findings. - The PR does not change the **Merge authority** or **Review blocking level** bullets in Operator choices. Changes to those need the operator's merge. - The PR does not delete or weaken an existing test assertion, unless all of these hold: - the operator ordered that change in their own words in a comment on the linked issue (a comment written by the operator, not a decision an agent posted on their behalf); - the PR body links that comment, quotes it, and lists each deleted or weakened assertion; - the merging agent re-reads the comment on the tracker immediately before merging. If it cannot be read, the exception does not apply. Otherwise it needs the operator's merge. The governing rule is the AGENTS.md on `main`, not the copy in the PR branch. CI and both reviews must be at the PR's current head commit. Any new push needs CI and both reviews again. CI red, pending or missing means no merge. The agent re-checks every condition immediately before merging. Agents never push to `main` directly and never force-push.
Review findings are blocking at HIGH severity and above.

Purity rule is binding: core carries no project content and no vocabulary from any specific driver, tracker or project; adapters only under integrations/. docs/PRODUCT.md sections 3, 6 and 7 are binding for all epics.
